build_attention_module: build a Gemma4 Attention module with GQA, RoPE, and optional sliding window attention
build_embedder_module: build an Embedder module to encode tokens, vision, and audio into embedding space
build_transformer_block: build a Gemma4 Block with attention, feed-forward, and optional MoE expert routing
build_feedforward_module: build a Gemma4 FeedForward module with GELU-gated linear units and einsum projections
init_kv_cache: create a LayerCache dictionary with zeroed key, value, position, and end_index arrays
